newsitem.title: USA: Jaymark Inc IPO postponed -- underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Jaymark Inc IPO postponed -- underwriter.

text.p: The planned initial public offering in Jaymark Inc was postponed, lead underwriter Brean Murray & Co Inc said on Thursday.
No reason was given for the postponement.
The offering had an estimated price range of $12 to $14 and proposed 1.3 million shares to trade under the symbol "JMRK" on the Nasdaq National Market on Thursday.
Last month an amended registration statement was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of 1.3 million shares of Jaymark class A common stock.
The company amended the filing to include updated financial results for the year ended January 31.
Jaymark, based in San Diego, California, provides advanced technology products and services to the Department of Defense and other government agencies.
